thesis: Cole Smead argues that investing success is largely a negative art focused on eliminating bad things rather than making unique decisions. He illustrates this by explaining that he seeks out situations where he is opposed to the crowd, noting that while others chase hot stocks, he recognizes their impending misery and instead bets on consistent businesses like beer distributors or horse racing favorites where risk is understood.
